current_row_level.label: Current row-level registry
current_row_level.meaning: Published facility/request rows retained in REGISTRY_DATA and shown in the main registry table.

additional_known_miso.label: Additional MISO requests held outside the row-level table
additional_known_miso.meaning: MISO live >=100 MW requests whose public source omitted state/location fields required by the current row-level schema. They are not site-level rows and are not assigned guessed locations.

historical_archive.label: Historical archived registry snapshot
historical_archive.meaning: Prior point-in-time publication preserved separately for auditability; not additive to the current row-level or expanded-known totals.

accounting_rule: Do not treat the 83 additional MISO requests or the 1802-record historical snapshot as independent additive facility populations beyond the explicitly defined arithmetic above.
